All four selected tank bodies remain within the narrow viewport. Target is a small noncircular cross and straight link; body/prop shadows remain legible without added halo.
Four flying Carriers keep detached silhouette shadows and original child indicators. Terrain still has the inherited dark material treatment; later terrain/readability work stays open.

Direct full-image comparison: snow texture and industrial pad remain unchanged in placement; props and bodies have local projected silhouettes. No repeated shadow striping or contact halo observed. Marines remain small at the unchanged inherited camera scale.

Direct full-image comparison: original lava cracks stay emissive; dark terrain and small normal gameplay footprint remain inherited limitations. No generic anchor outline or extra radius circle is present.
Direct full-image comparison: four native flying body silhouettes retain separated displaced shadows; terrain and props keep original positions. No added body crop or contact darkening halo observed.
Native fighting view: distinct turret/body silhouettes and their projections remain readable among the same four tank identities; no generic attack-radius framing.
Native half-second death view: original fading fragments and smoke remain; no solid fake body appears in the fading effect. Projection is small and follows surviving physical remnants.
Native 0.2-second death view: four native body remnants retain source organic death colour and local silhouettes, without a new ground-radius outline or contact halo.

Native hero death at 0.5 seconds retains separate original organic bodies/fragments and their current-pose silhouettes; no generic added radius marker is present.

limits: All visual repair and traceable matched original SC2 actual-client comparisons precede overall performance/FPS/quality tiers; repeat visual checks after performance changes.

Five-second paused costs and 20-second controlled native combat recordings do not establish stable FPS, natural campaign, high-density performance, physical-device, high-refresh or low-memory acceptance.

All 138 complete-body portraits start at native tick 300 and advance another 300 steps, captured at tick 600 / 10 seconds. Fourteen groups with Birth clips additionally use paired five-map/mobile captures at tick 600. All other views retain the exact captured native time.

Ground art, five-map composition, full effect restoration, dynamic clarity, camera changes, original-client and human approval remain later work; no fabricated original counterpart for custom elites or maps.

The first shadow candidate has visible ground self-shadow striping and is retained as a failed visual candidate. The first acid browser fixture used a Marine whose normal stat refresh invalidated the artificial HP setup; the corrected fixture uses a native Thor. Early profile-import revision/unit-test fixture failures remain recorded.

The first formal Web action exceeded its 25-second acknowledgement timeout after reaching battle. The second run was interrupted by a native economic rescue reward while checking target cancellation; the final UI fixture explicitly isolates those timed events without modifying production rules. The longer recorded timeout verifies functionality only. The first package omitted two prior UI reference documents; the final package restores both unchanged. No old evidence is relabelled.

The first final mobile matrix stopped at 102 of 108 records with six empty Shader logs and three GPU preparation failures while loading Protoss heroes. Its white-canvas screenshot and actual build are retained; no root cause is claimed. The later offline run exposed a separately reproducible repeated contact shader injection through preserved template callbacks; candidate-r4 fixes this and repeats the full final matrix. Earlier passing candidate-r3 evidence is not relabelled.

The first controls run passed desktop and landscape, then timed out on a portrait minimap touch. Instrumented reproduction recorded native pointer events retargeted to map-toggle despite DOM canvas hit-testing. The final fixture taps the map interior and asserts the actual canvas event target; no production input rules or UI changed.

Current-schema diagnostic imports test real controls and exact restoration; they do not establish old-save matching or migration. Source gaps, Science Vessel, P6-V01 and production/B4 gates remain open.
